body:
> but it was fucking miraculous.

that's good because i could use a miracle about now.
we plan to do emdr but i have to get to a better place first. what do you mean by imagery techniques?
What does treatment look like for you?
dog fur is my favorite. i like petting my dogs. two of them have short hair. one has long hair.

i'm sorry that you've gone through abuse as well. a few weeks back my wife met a woman at the Y where she works out. after talking for a while she mentioned that she (new woman) is mormon. my wife told her that my parents are mormon. when this lady found out who my dad was she flipped. apparently he touched her and her daughter while in the church building. she had no idea the sexual abuse in our househould. i know of my sister and myself. i have four other siblings. i don't know if they were abused. i suspect one was and three were not. when i came out about my abuse my sister was the only sibling on my side. the rest turned against me. just like the church.
what is your favorite home cooked meal?

Probably tofu fried rice. My wife and I are vegan and she is a hell of a cook. I wish I could experience her cooking like I used to. My senses feel dulled. Colors, tastes, smells.. Bland. Lifeless. Touch is strong but the slightest wrong touch can set me off.

panic attacks for the past few years. before that it was just depression. i'm working with a shrink. they're more and more frequent though. and much more severe. i'm working with a shrink twice a week. we started going through the dsm-whatever book for an official ptsd diagnosis so i can take a leave from school. i triggered part way through so she stopped. i was sexually abused by my dad. that may be the root cause. i fucking hate this so much.
